title.en: Your home as a grocer, a neighbour's robot and an insurer would see it

goal.en: Run the same twelve household facts through three recipient roles and count what each receives: five constraints, three, none. No value ever appears: a budget cap is a cap, not your income.

note.en: The grocer: allergen block, labelling, delivery window, access point, budget cap.
A second robot: no-movement zone, pet-safe storage, available equipment.
An insurer: nothing from this household, which has no device fault facet.
In every answer the disclosed list is empty: no raw fact travelled to anyone.

outcome.en: You can see, for any role, what leaves your home before it leaves. Next: 089 follows one allergy to two different recipients.
